sources: recreation.gov public campsite search for facility 233131 (catx.py: 84 sites incl. host)

values.note: $26 non-electric, $35 electric; includes 2 vehicles, $9 each additional vehicle. 'Federal Recreation Passes not applicable toward additional vehicle or electric fees.'

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/rainbow-point-campground ('$26.00 includes 2 driving vehicles. $9.00 each additional vehicle. $35.00 for electrical sites.'; the same box's older '$20 / $28 / $8' lines are superseded) + recreation.gov /rates (Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 09-26: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 26, STANDARD ELECTRIC 35), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/rainbow-point-campground ('Electrical Sites: 46', 'All of loops B and C are electric') + rec.gov catalog (46 STANDARD ELECTRIC sites, 18 of them listing 50 amps, the rest no amperage; water hookup 'No' on all 84), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Trailer/RV average parking spur 60' x 33'. Rec.gov lists a length for only 27 of 84 sites (24-52 ft).

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/rainbow-point-campground ('Camp sites: 83', 'Trailer/RV Sites Average Parking Spur: 60' x 33'') + rec.gov catalog (max vehicle length up to 52 ft), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/rainbow-point-campground ('Vault toilets and drinking water are provided', 'Potable water is available at this site.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233131 (notices 'No RV Dump Station is located in any of the USFS campgrounds managed by ExplorUS in the Custer-Gallatin National Forest.', 'There are NO Shower facilities available at this campground.'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/rainbow-point-campground (Seasons of Use: 'May 15 - September 27. Weather Dependent.'; last updated May 1, 2026), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Run by a concessionaire (Rocky Mountain Recreation Company per the Forest Service page; recreation.gov's contact email and notices name ExplorUS). 83 of 84 catalogued sites are reservable.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/rainbow-point-campground ('Reservations: Make Reservations Here', 'Rocky Mountain Recreation Company: (661) 702-1420') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233131 (rules maxConsecutiveStay 16; catalog 83 reservable, 1 not), read 2026-10-22

note: Custer Gallatin NF campground on Rainbow Bay of Hebgen Lake, ~5 mi N of West Yellowstone then W on Rainbow Point Rd (FR 6954, gravel). Loops B and C are the electric loops; boat ramp in the campground. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov (concessionaire Rocky Mountain Recreation Company/ExplorUS; reservable): confirmed $26-$35, 50-amp electric, no water hookups, vault toilets, drinking water, no dump, reservable. Changed count 85 -> 83 (FS) and max_rig_ft 40 -> 52 (catalog; 40 was from note prose). Added no showers, season 5/15 - 9/27, rec.gov platform, 16-night limit. No alert for the campground or Rainbow Point Rd (the Lonesomewood burn closure is north of the lake). Note corrected (it said 15 electric sites; there are 46) and trimmed of restated values.
flags: Missing phone: the FS page and recreation.gov give the concessionaire, (661) 702-1420; Hebgen Lake Ranger District is 1-406-823-6961.
Waterfront re-audit lead: recreation.gov says the campground 'is located on the banks of scenic Hebgen Lake' and lists Beach Access and Lake Access; entry is 'not waterfront'.
